_comment: openai/gpt-oss-20b, translated from the upstream HuggingFace config.json for Frontier's HF loader. Deviations from upstream are listed in _frontier_deviations below and are load-bearing for fidelity.

_frontier_deviations.num_experts: Upstream names the expert count 'num_local_experts' (32). Frontier's MoE detection in BaseModelConfig._create_from_hf_json reads 'num_experts', so it is mirrored here. Both keys are kept so the file still diffs cleanly against upstream.
_frontier_deviations.moe_intermediate_size: Upstream gpt-oss has a single 'intermediate_size' (2880) that is the per-expert SwiGLU FFN width. Frontier reads MoE FFN width from 'moe_intermediate_size', so it is mirrored here with the same value.
_frontier_deviations.quantization_config: Upstream ships MXFP4 expert weights. Frontier's QuantizationConfig only accepts quant_method in {None, 'fp8'}, so the block is omitted and this config models the BF16 variant. Expert-GEMM latency and weight memory will therefore both be overstated relative to real MXFP4 serving.
_frontier_deviations.sliding_window / layer_types: Kept for provenance only. Frontier's HF loader does not read them and there is no sliding-window attention family, so every layer is simulated as full attention. Long-context attention cost and KV-cache footprint are overstated as a result.
_frontier_deviations.attention_sinks: gpt-oss uses learned per-head attention sinks. Frontier has no sink concept in any attention family (dense/MLA/DSA); the model binds to the dense family and sinks are not modeled.
_frontier_deviations.torch_dtype: Set explicitly to bfloat16; upstream omits it and Frontier would otherwise default to float16.
